tools.description: Set a typed parameter. Key format namespace.group.name (e.g. ferro.common.comments, acme.energy.conductivity). Value forms: (1) a quantity with a unit as text: "0.8 W/mK", "1200 kg/m3", "35 MPa", "0.25 W/m2K", "20 °C", "120 kgCO2e", "3m" (if the key has a quantity definition, a bare number in text uses its default unit); (2) {"spec": "density", "value": 1200, "unit": "kg/m3"} (no unit = SI storage unit; length mm, angle rad); (3) {"type": "text"|"integer"|"bool"|"tags"|"element_ref"|"number", "value": ...}; also plain numbers, booleans and string arrays (tags). Specs: length, area, volume, angle, mass, density, force, moment, pressure, stress, thermal_conductivity, thermal_resistance, u_value, heat_capacity, temperature, power, illuminance, flow, currency, carbon_mass, time, ratio, number. Fails if the key's definition has another type. Computed keys (ferro.form.*, ferro.dimensions.*) are read-only.
tools.name: set_parameter

tools.description: Define a project parameter key (like a Revit shared parameter): data type, group, instance / type binding, description and optional IFC property set mapping. Values set later must fit the type. Built-in ferro.* keys cannot be defined. Returns {key, uid}; pass `uid` (a Revit shared parameter GUID) to match an existing Revit parameter.

data_type.description: "text"|"integer"|"bool"|"tags"|"element_ref" or {"quantity": "<spec>"}, e.g. {"quantity": "u_value"}. Specs: length, area, volume, angle, mass, density, force, moment, pressure, stress, thermal_conductivity, thermal_resistance, u_value, heat_capacity, temperature, power, illuminance, flow, currency, carbon_mass, time, ratio, number

tools.description: Switch where an element's geometry comes from.
